overview_description.description: Overlord Labs builds a silicon-first battery intelligence platform that embeds precision analog sensing and advanced control algorithms directly into Battery Management System (BMS) integrated circuits. The platform enables safer, longer-lasting, and more adaptive batteries by executing physics-based algorithms at the silicon level—unlocking compatibility across next-generation chemistries and compact, always-on devices. Overlord Labs is developing infrastructure-grade battery intelligence to power the next wave of AI-native and edge devices.
